# Achievement Index

Canonical, machine-readable list of all GitHub Achievements known to this repo.

## Schema

Each entry maps to `_achievements/<slug>/meta.yaml`. The index is generated from those files by `_scripts/list_achievements.py`.

`--check` in CI to prove this table still matches the catalog.

## Highlights (account-tier, not activity-based)

These are **not** generated: none are activity-based, so none carry a
`verified:` block, and this table is maintained by hand.

| `github-pro` | GitHub Pro | No | Unobtainable |

| `security-bug-bounty-hunter` | Security Bug Bounty Hunter | No | Unobtainable |
| `github-campus-expert` | GitHub Campus Expert | No | Unobtainable |

> A fifth badge, **Security Advisory Credit**, was previously listed here with a
> link to `_highlights/security-advisory-credit/`. No folder, `meta.yaml`, or
> `README.md` ever existed for it, so the entry was a broken link rather than a
> catalog record. It has been removed rather than stubbed, because publishing an
> achievement page we cannot describe is the same failure mode this repo exists
> to fix. Add it properly — folder, `meta.yaml`, `README.md` — if GitHub's
> current badge set warrants it.

## How to add a new achievement

1. Create `_achievements/<slug>/meta.yaml` matching `ACHIEVEMENT_FORMAT.md`.
2. Create `_achievements/<slug>/README.md` with all 11 required sections.
3. Optionally add `_achievements/<slug>/earn.sh`.
4. Run `python _scripts/list_achievements.py --write` — this regenerates the
   table above **and** the one in `README.md` from `meta.yaml`. Do not hand-edit
   either; they are generated.
5. Run `python _scripts/list_achievements.py --check` and
   `python _scripts/grant_check.py` to prove both tables match reality.
6. Open a PR.

The two tables were previously hand-edited in four places, which is how
`pull-shark` sat at `Not yet` while holding a Silver badge. The
`BEGIN:ACHIEVEMENT_INDEX` / `BEGIN:ACHIEVEMENT_CATALOG` marker pairs now delimit
the generated regions, and CI fails if either drifts.
